build_graph_with_plates_and_edges: build a Graph with nested plates and edges between nodes using with_plate and with_edge
export_graph_to_dot: export a Graph to DOT language format using to_dot for visualization
check_dag_isomorphism: check if two DAG roots are isomorphic using are_dags_isomorphic with a kernel function
merge_isomorphic_nodes: merge isomorphic nodes in a Graph using merge_isomorphic or merge_isomorphic_many
find_reachable_nodes: find all reachable nodes from a given node using the reachable method
